comment: Ortho-fused bicycles at every hydrogenation level, no oxo, whose generated name does not round-trip through OPSIN. Enumerated by tests/roundtrip/test_fused_ring_family.py, not drawn from any dataset. Shrinking this list is progress; growing it is a regression.
note: All four remaining entries are fully mancude systems with no indicated hydrogen, where several maximum non-cumulative double-bond arrangements of the same skeleton exist. IUPAC names the ring system, not one arrangement, so the name cannot distinguish them and OPSIN returns a different Kekule form of the same named compound. Verify before removing: the generated name may already be correct.
